capabilities: Chat with vault notes using local LLMs
Search the vault for relevant context and cite specific notes
Focus conversations on notes open in tabs
Swap and configure models through LM Studio
Tune models, search parameters, and token limits for local hardware
extras: Setup instructions are limited to install/enable steps; no troubleshooting or configuration details beyond a feature list.
motivation: The author built it because other AI plugins send users' notes to someone's servers, and they wanted fully local, private AI chat.
problem: Other AI plugins send note contents to external servers, which is a privacy risk for sensitive notes.
summary: Chat with your notes using locally hosted LLMs via LM Studio, keeping all notes and processing on your own device.
